answer: Agents selling comet images from a ridge above a glacier must bond each delivery contract. If a seller signs two incompatible exclusive ownership receipts for the same image, a buyer can present both signatures to confiscate that contract bond. Withdrawal waits beyond the dispute window, and changing account keys cannot release an old bond. Every alias must fund its own liability, so abandoning names does not erase the cost of double-selling. This requires enforceable receipt rules and bonds larger than the fraud gain.
